news.title: Dean Robert Berry joins national council shaping how teachers are prepared for the age of AI
news.summary_en: Berry has been named to the Educator Preparation Advisory Council (EPAC), a new national council convened by Ed3 Global and Deans for Impact (DFI) which brings together higher-education and educator-preparation leaders to guide how future teachers are prepared for an education system and workforce being transformed by artificial intelligence (AI).
